trademark_sources.label: USPTO Trademark Search
trademark_sources.notes: Federal marks only. Search similar marks and related goods/services; state and common-law use need separate review. TSDR retrieves known cases, not comprehensive name search.

business_sources.label: SBA state registration directory
business_sources.notes: Choose the relevant state and local DBA registers; no single US company-name clearance register.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.

trademark_sources.label: EUIPO eSearch and TMview
trademark_sources.notes: Search EUTMs and participating national offices; inspect office coverage and update dates.

trademark_sources.label: EUIPO Trademark Search API
trademark_sources.notes: Official EUIPO REST API; subscription/sign-in and plan-specific rate limits. Not implemented in this toolkit.

business_sources.label: European e-Justice business registers
business_sources.notes: BRIS interconnects national registers; company forms and data availability vary. This is not a single EU business-name reservation service.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.

trademark_sources.label: UK IPO trademark search
trademark_sources.notes: Search UK marks and international marks designating UK; separate Crown Dependency registers may apply.

business_sources.label: Companies House
business_sources.notes: Company register does not replace trademark or trading-name checks.

business_sources.label: Companies House search API
business_sources.notes: API key required; 600 requests per five minutes. Availability restrictions are documented. Not implemented here.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.

trademark_sources.label: IP Viet Nam search guidance
trademark_sources.notes: Use the official WIPO Publish trademark search linked by the office; search Vietnamese diacritics and variants. No authorized public search API verified.

trademark_sources.label: WIPO Publish official user guide
trademark_sources.notes: National published applications and records require verification of current coverage and lag.

business_sources.label: National Business Registration Portal
business_sources.notes: Search entity names and local-language variants. No authorized public search API verified.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.

trademark_sources.label: CNIPA Trademark services
trademark_sources.notes: Use official trademark search; check Chinese characters, pinyin and Latin variants. Respect login and challenge requirements.

trademark_sources.label: CNIPA public service platform
trademark_sources.notes: Advertises trademark data opening, batch data and interfaces; authorization and redistribution terms must be verified before integration.

business_sources.label: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
business_sources.notes: Official SAMR registry. Automated fetch returned 403 in research; do not bypass restrictions. No public API access verified.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.

trademark_sources.label: DPMAregister
trademark_sources.notes: German marks plus EU and international marks protecting Germany. Register status updated daily; publication cadence differs. DPMAconnectPlus is the official bulk/interface route requiring separate onboarding.

business_sources.label: Joint Register Portal
business_sources.notes: Search federal-state commercial and related registers; not a full inventory of every trading name. No public API access verified.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.

trademark_sources.label: Rospatent Search Platform
trademark_sources.notes: Official platform includes registered Russian, well-known and internationally protected marks; verify pending-application coverage separately. Search Cyrillic and Latin variants. No public API access verified.

business_sources.label: Federal Tax Service EGRUL/EGRIP
business_sources.notes: Search legal entity names in Cyrillic and relevant variants. No public API access verified.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.

trademark_sources.label: IPOS Digital Hub
trademark_sources.notes: Use Similar Mark Search for similarity; basic search is prefix-oriented. Newly filed marks can be delayed. No public API access verified.

business_sources.label: ACRA Bizfile
business_sources.notes: Search entity names/UEN. Name approval and trademark rights are separate. No public search API access verified.

cross_border_sources.label: WIPO Global Brand Database
cross_border_sources.notes: Automatic querying/search/download is expressly prohibited. Coverage varies by office; check national registers too.
